clinician.trajectory_summary: A 55-year-old male with vascular risk factors including hypertension, diabetes, dyslipidemia, prior stroke and TIA presented with dizziness, instability, memory loss, and low mood over one year. Doppler ultrasound showed initial dilation and low flow with suspected distal subocclusion of the right internal carotid artery and decreased flow in vertebrobasilar arteries. CTA confirmed bilateral internal carotid artery kinking. SPECT brain perfusion imaging with 99mTc-HMPAO verified global cortical hypoperfusion, consistent with chronic vascular failure.
